papers.name: BrainHGT
papers.title: BrainHGT: A Hierarchical Graph Transformer for Interpretable Brain Network Analysis
papers.summary: 把脑区连接先组织成局部与长程关系，再组织成功能社区，最后根据社区间关系分类。论文方法图与作者实现、本项目适配分别标注。

papers.name: DCSTN
papers.title: Guiding fusion of dynamic functional and effective connectivity in spatio-temporal graph neural network for brain disorder classification
papers.summary: 同一段BOLD生成动态功能连接和跨窗口定向依赖两路图，分别提取空间信息，再由EC引导时间融合。

papers.name: STAGIN
papers.title: Learning Dynamic Graph Representation of Brain Connectome with Spatio-Temporal Attention
papers.summary: 将连续窗口脑图交给GIN，在每层利用空间注意力读出重要脑区，再由时间Transformer汇总重要窗口。

papers.name: BrainLM
papers.title: BrainLM: A Foundation Model for Brain Activity Recordings
papers.summary: 预训练时遮住一部分脑区时间片段，学习补回信号；下游任务复用编码器表示。

papers.name: FMM
papers.title: Foundation-Model-Boosted Multimodal Learning for fMRI-based Neuropathic Pain Drug Response Prediction
papers.summary: 同一次扫描提供时间序列和FC矩阵；冻结BrainLM处理时序，从头训练ResNet处理FC，拼接后预测药物反应。

papers.name: Meta-matching
papers.title: Meta-matching as a simple framework to translate phenotypic predictive models from big to small data
papers.summary: 在大队列先学会预测多个已有表型；小队列只用少量标签选择或组合这些预测，使其适应新表型。

papers.name: Multilayer meta-matching
papers.title: Multilayer meta-matching: Translating phenotypic prediction models from multiple datasets to small data
papers.summary: 把多个来源队列的表型预测器组织成由大到小的迁移层次，最后用少量目标样本堆叠预测新表型。

papers.name: Brain-JEPA
papers.title: Brain-JEPA: Brain Dynamics Foundation Model with Gradient Positioning and Spatiotemporal Masking
papers.summary: 看见一部分脑活动，预测其他脑区/时间块的潜在表示；用功能梯度编码脑区位置，以EMA目标网络提供训练目标。

papers.name: NeuroSTORM
papers.title: Towards a general-purpose foundation model for functional MRI analysis
papers.summary: 直接编码4D体素序列，以移位窗口Mamba提取多尺度时空特征，预训练丢弃可轻易互相推断的局部信息，下游使用任务提示适配。

papers.name: Pediatric headache
papers.title: A foundation-model approach to pediatric headache classification from resting-state fMRI
papers.summary: 将儿童头痛fMRI交给冻结NeuroSTORM，池化为288维表示，再训练L1 Logistic；FC与人口学模型作为平行比较。

papers.name: ScaPT
papers.title: Prompt Your Brain: Scaffold Prompt Tuning for Efficient Adaptation of fMRI Pre-trained Model
papers.summary: 冻结已有fMRI模型，先在多表型来源任务学习可组合提示，再用目标任务少量标签学习目标提示；输入通过DIP映射决定提示组合权重。

papers.name: Omni-fMRI
papers.title: Omni-fMRI: A Universal Atlas-Free fMRI Foundation Model
papers.summary: 按信号复杂度把体素分成大小不同的patch、去掉背景，再用全局ViT编码；不同尺度有各自重建头和归一化损失。

papers.name: fMRI-LM
papers.title: fMRI-LM: Towards a Universal Foundation Model for Language-Aligned fMRI Understanding
papers.summary: 先把fMRI编码成与文本空间相关的离散token，再训练语言模型同时处理脑活动token和描述文本，最后进行任务指令训练。

papers.name: ALTER
papers.title: Long-range Brain Graph Transformer
papers.summary: 根据脑区相关强度调节随机游走结构编码，把长程嵌入与节点特征拼接，再用Transformer及聚类读出进行分类。

papers.name: GCN
papers.title: Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks
papers.summary: 根据连接图汇总节点邻居信息，预测节点类别。本地未找到原文，只展示已登记的方法层次和本项目适配边界。

papers.name: GAT
papers.title: Graph Attention Networks
papers.summary: 学习每个节点应当多重视哪些邻居，再加权汇总信息。本地原文缺失，此图限定在已有登记和早期实现说明。

papers.name: BrainGNN
papers.title: BrainGNN: Interpretable Brain Graph Neural Network for fMRI Analysis
papers.summary: 利用ROI身份感知的图卷积和可解释节点池化学习脑图。本地尚无论文全文，原始细节保留待核。

papers.name: FastSurferVINN
papers.title: FastSurferVINN: A voxel-size independent network for fast and accurate brain segmentation
papers.summary: 在网络内部把不同体素大小的特征归一到共同分辨率，再映回原分辨率；三个二维视角的分割共同形成三维脑结构标签。

papers.name: FewPair
papers.title: A pairwise functional connectivity similarity measure method based on few-shot learning for early MCI detection
papers.summary: 把每次扫描转为动态FC序列，由共享注意力网络处理两个人，再比较对应连接的变化相似度，依据支持者类别判断查询者。

papers.name: Prototypical Networks
papers.title: Prototypical Networks for Few-shot Learning
papers.summary: 把每类少数支持样本的表示求平均作为原型，查询样本靠近哪个原型就分到哪类。原论文目前只有本地摘要。

papers.name: SimpleShot
papers.title: SimpleShot: Revisiting Nearest-Neighbor Classification for Few-Shot Learning
papers.summary: 固定已有网络特征，先做均值中心化与L2归一化，再以最近邻规则分类。本地只保存原作者摘要。

papers.name: SimCLR
papers.title: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
papers.summary: 同一样本产生两种增强视图，共享编码器学习表示，再经非线性投影做对比学习；下游使用投影前表示。

papers.name: AgeTL
papers.title: Transfer learning improves resting-state functional connectivity pattern analysis using convolutional neural networks
papers.summary: 先在较大静息连接队列训练CNN，再迁移到较小队列做年龄预测。当前本机缺少原文，只能展示已登记迁移流程。

papers.name: CVsmall
papers.title: Cross-validation failure: small sample sizes lead to large error bars
papers.summary: 研究小样本下交叉验证分数的不确定性，提醒折间标准误往往低估真实误差。这是评估流程论文。

papers.name: CVguideline
papers.title: Assessing and tuning brain decoders: cross-validation, caveats, and guidelines
papers.summary: 把超参数选择和最终评估分开，讨论留一法的不稳定、重复随机划分及嵌套交叉验证。

papers.name: TLPO
papers.title: Tournament Leave-pair-out Cross-validation for Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) Analysis
papers.summary: 每次留出一对样本，用同一个模型比较这一对；再把所有成对胜负组成锦标赛，以胜场排序绘制ROC。

papers.name: LOO distributional bias
papers.title: Distributional bias compromises leave-one-out cross-validation
papers.summary: 讨论留一交叉验证中训练标签组成随被留出标签而变化，可能造成跨折分数偏差。当前本机缺少论文全文。

papers.name: TRIPOD+AI
papers.title: TRIPOD+AI statement: updated guidance for reporting clinical prediction models that use regression or machine learning methods
papers.summary: 临床预测研究的报告规范，要求说明人群、终点、建模和验证。这是报告流程，不能绘成神经网络或当作提高AUC的模块。

papers.name: CLIP
papers.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
papers.summary: 分别编码配对图像与自然语言，让正确配对的表示相似，再用类别文本和新图像的相似度分类。本地没有CLIP原论文全文。

papers.name: DEIPP
papers.title: Personalized brain decoding of spontaneous pain in individuals with chronic pain
papers.summary: 对两位慢性疼痛患者各自长期密集采集fMRI及疼痛评分，建立个人模型跟踪疼痛变化。跨人迁移失败属于原文关键边界。

papers.name: CoSpine
papers.title: CoSpine open access simultaneous cortico-spinal fMRI database of thermal pain and motor tasks
papers.summary: 同步采集全脑和颈髓的任务数据集；图示展示采集、分区预处理及任务激活验证流程。

papers.name: RPN
papers.title: Pain-free resting-state functional brain connectivity predicts individual pain sensitivity
papers.summary: 用无痛静息态的偏相关连接，经训练内标准化、筛选和Elastic Net预测个人实验痛敏感性。

papers.name: Cortico
papers.title: A corticospinal signature for interindividual pain sensitivity
papers.summary: 将脑、脑干和颈髓连接共同送入Elastic Net，预测热痛阈值，并分开验证重测、独立参与者、患者与刺激条件。

papers.name: Peyron
papers.title: Investigating brain dysfunction in neuropathic pain with MRI
papers.summary: 同一神经病理痛患者不同刺激条件的任务研究；当前仅能依据本地历史原文核查报告重绘概略流程。

papers.name: TNcouple
papers.title: Transcriptional correlates of structure-function coupling plasticity in trigeminal neuralgia: unveiling the synaptic and metabolic associations
papers.summary: 用结构连接的图谐波解释功能连接，获得脑区耦合强度，再关联治疗变化和健康转录组空间分布。

papers.name: TNdata
papers.title: A large-scale dataset of pre- and postsurgical MRI data from patients with chronic trigeminal neuralgia
papers.summary: 公开三叉神经痛术前术后多模态MRI和临床资料，研究流程以采集、随访、去标识与质控为核心。

papers.name: ZANpaper
papers.title: Maladaptive reorganization of mediodorsal thalamus as a central mechanism in neuropathic pain-related sleep disorders
papers.summary: 联合睡眠多导记录、脑电同步和丘脑结构/功能指标，研究带状疱疹相关痛的睡眠不稳定。

papers.name: Migraine
papers.title: An fMRI-based neural marker for migraine without aura
papers.summary: Dosenbach160连接经训练内统计筛选及SVM-RFE，形成偏头痛分类标记，再独立验证诊断、特异性和治疗相关性。

papers.name: MBSR
papers.title: Enhanced mindfulness based stress reduction (MBSR+) in episodic migraine: a randomized clinical trial with MRI outcomes
papers.summary: 增强正念减压对照头痛压力管理的随机试验，分别追踪日记头痛和结构、静息及任务MRI变化。

papers.name: MigGM
papers.title: Differences in gray matter volume in episodic migraine patients with and without prior diagnosis or clinical care: a cross-sectional study
papers.summary: 比较有无既往诊疗经历的偏头痛患者灰质体积，并关联头痛和心理量表；这是结构影像横断面研究。

papers.name: EmoData
papers.title: A behavioral and brain imaging dataset with focus on emotion regulation of women with fibromyalgia
papers.summary: 33名纤维肌痛女性和33名对照的多模态开放数据，配套情绪调节任务、任务内疼痛和临床资料。

papers.name: EmoML
papers.title: Functional brain changes in Mexican women with fibromyalgia
papers.summary: 基于墨西哥纤维肌痛女性队列的功能连接机器学习与症状关联；本地未取得原文，仅保留概略分析链。

papers.name: PRTtrial
papers.title: Effect of Pain Reprocessing Therapy vs Placebo and Usual Care for Patients With Chronic Back Pain: A Randomized Clinical Trial
papers.summary: 慢性背痛患者随机接受疼痛再加工疗法、安慰剂或常规护理，追踪疼痛及影像变化；当前为本地研究记录层级。

papers.name: AHin
papers.title: Auditory Hyperresponsivity in Chronic Back Pain: A Randomized Controlled Trial of Pain Reprocessing Therapy
papers.summary: 用声音和压力刺激比较慢性背痛超敏，结合ROI、既有多变量标记、探索性分类和PRT纵向治疗分析。

papers.name: PainDL
papers.title: Using Deep Learning and Resting-State fMRI to Classify Chronic Pain Conditions
papers.summary: 比较不同图谱、Pearson/DTW连接与卷积网络及传统自动建模；独立留出人先隔离，再在训练内部扩增和调参。

papers.name: FM2022
papers.title: Identification of Resting-State Network Functional Connectivity and Brain Structural Signatures in Fibromyalgia Using a Machine Learning Approach
papers.summary: 分别从功能连接和灰质体积筛选分类特征，再组合两模态，以留一验证比较纤维肌痛判别。

papers.name: ToPS
papers.title: A neuroimaging biomarker for sustained experimental and clinical pain
papers.summary: 面向持续实验痛和临床疼痛的多尺度连接标记；本地未取得全文，当前仅展示已记录的概略流程。

papers.name: Sens2019
papers.title: The medial temporal lobe in nociception: a meta-analytic and functional connectivity study
papers.summary: 结合痛觉文献荟萃与静息连接研究内侧颞叶；原文未在本地取得，当前图仅为记录支持的概略流程。

papers.name: IPD
papers.title: Convergent structural brain alterations in chronic pain: a multi-metric individual participant data meta-analysis
papers.summary: 跨队列统一处理个体T1，多指标提取与质控后，先算各研究效应量再整合慢性痛结构改变。

papers.name: HzGrad
papers.title: Functional connectome gradient alterations in herpes zoster and postherpetic neuralgia: associations with gene expression profiles
papers.summary: 从静息FC得到低维功能梯度，比较急慢性带状疱疹痛，再用健康转录组空间分布解释梯度差异。

papers.name: HzDyn
papers.title: Abnormal intrinsic brain functional network dynamics in patients with postherpetic neuralgia
papers.summary: 滑窗FC经K-means得到三种状态，比较状态停留、转换及动态图指标与带状疱疹痛的关系。

papers.name: TNrec
papers.title: Individualized rs-fMRI reveals brain-circuit heterogeneity and predicts early recurrence in trigeminal neuralgia
papers.summary: 先把每位TN患者ReHo与健康模板比较得到异常区，再结合临床变量探索射频术后早期复发。

papers.name: Chronify
papers.title: Thalamocortical and corticostriatal pathways in the progression from acute to chronic musculoskeletal pain: An fMRI study
papers.summary: 从急性肌骨痛的丘脑皮层与皮层纹状体连接研究后续慢性化；本轮仅依据本地历史摘要重绘概略预测链。

papers.name: Acu
papers.title: Acupuncture for Migraine Without Aura and Connection-Based Efficacy Prediction: A Randomized Clinical Trial
papers.summary: 偏头痛针刺RCT中的连接预测分析，采用影像子样本CPM留一验证；试验疗效和个体疗效预测分开评价。

papers.name: Affective
papers.title: Neural and psychosocial signatures of the comorbidity between pain and affective symptoms
papers.summary: 分别以奖励任务影像和心理社会信息做多任务学习，共同预测疼痛与情绪症状，再评估堆叠融合。

papers.name: Stroke
papers.title: Structural network dysfunction and aberrant SC-FC coupling correlate with central post-stroke pain of thalamic origin
papers.summary: 结合扩散谱与静息MRI研究丘脑卒中后中枢痛的结构网络及SC-FC耦合；当前依据本地摘要重绘流程。

papers.name: Location
papers.title: Predicting pain location from resting-state brain fMRI
papers.summary: 联合静息连接和身体图上的疼痛/异常感觉位置做交叉分解；本地只有预印本研究摘要。

papers.name: NeuPSIG
papers.title: Neuropathic pain: an updated grading system for research and clinical practice
papers.summary: 神经病理性疼痛的证据分级框架；流程依据病史、解剖分布、体征和确认检查，不是疼痛强度模型。

papers.name: PupilRec
papers.title: Publication guidelines and recommendations for pupillary measurement in psychophysiological studies
papers.summary: 瞳孔测量及报告建议，关注光照校准、伪迹和可复核报告；本轮仅有本地引用说明。

papers.name: DON
papers.title: Interhemispheric Functional Connectivity Alterations in Diabetic Optic Neuropathy: A Resting-State Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging Study
papers.summary: 比较糖尿病视神经病患者与健康人的左右半球镜像同步性，再检查差异脑区与视力、组别的关系。

papers.name: Eye
papers.title: Abnormalities of interhemispheric functional connectivity in individuals with acute eye pain: a resting-state fMRI study
papers.summary: 用镜像同源连接寻找急性眼痛的半球同步异常，结合临床相关和探索性ROC。

papers.name: TNdecode
papers.title: Imaging the neural substrate of trigeminal neuralgia pain using deep learning
papers.summary: 从TN患者持续自评疼痛的BOLD中，并行采用相关分析、体积CNN和连接图GCNN，寻找多种方法一致指向的脑区。

papers.name: TNSVM
papers.title: Stratifying trigeminal neuralgia and characterizing an abnormal property of brain functional organization: a resting-state fMRI and machine learning study
papers.summary: 从TN静息影像提取自发活动与连接指标，筛选特征后用SVM区分患者和健康人，并比较TN亚型。

papers.name: Survey
papers.title: Survey on Pain Detection Using Machine Learning Models: Narrative Review
papers.summary: 梳理面部、生理、声音和瞳孔等疼痛识别方法，展示自动评估的一般流程和早期/后期融合。

papers.name: DecodeReview
papers.title: Decoding pain: uncovering the factors that affect the performance of neuroimaging-based pain models
papers.summary: 文献调查与同一热痛数据集基准并行，区分数据层级、空间尺度、模型层级和训练人数对性能的影响。

papers.name: Mediation
papers.title: Multiple Brain Networks Mediating Stimulus–Pain Relationships in Humans
papers.summary: 学习使刺激到主观疼痛间接效应最大的全脑加权模式，形成多个正交中介方向并在独立数据验证。

papers.name: NPS
papers.title: An fMRI-Based Neurologic Signature of Physical Pain
papers.summary: 以LASSO正则化主成分回归训练分布式疼痛权重图，固定后与新影像点积得到签名反应，再检验特异性和药物反应。

papers.name: MinD-Vis
papers.title: Seeing Beyond the Brain: Conditional Diffusion Model with Sparse Masked Modeling for Vision Decoding
papers.summary: 先用未配对fMRI遮盖重建学习脑表征，再把少量配对视觉fMRI经双重条件送入潜空间扩散模型重建图像。

papers.name: NSD
papers.title: A massive 7T fMRI dataset to bridge cognitive and computational neuroscience
papers.summary: 对少数受试者密集采集自然场景视觉响应，提供高质量逐试次beta及多种空间表达，服务编码和解码研究。

papers.name: EReCu
papers.title: EReCu: Pseudo-label Evolution Fusion and Refinement with Multi-Cue Learning for Unsupervised Camouflage Detection
papers.summary: 在DINO教师—学生框架中，用纹理/语义线索、伪标签演化融合和局部细化学习无监督伪装目标分割。

papers.name: SNNReview
papers.title: Spiking Neural Networks for Multimodal Neuroimaging: A Comprehensive Review of Current Trends and the NeuCube Brain-Inspired Architecture
papers.summary: 综述脉冲神经网络和NeuCube的时空建模，比较模拟器，并提出CNN提空间特征再经脉冲编码的混合方向。

papers.name: MindEye2
papers.title: MindEye2: Shared-Subject Models Enable fMRI-To-Image With 1 Hour of Data
papers.summary: 以受试者专属线性映射连接共享MLP，联合扩散先验、检索和低层分支，使用少量新人数据适配后经SDXL重建图像。

papers.name: PupilPain
papers.title: Pupillometry as a Potential Objective Measurement of Pain Assessment in Healthy Volunteers
papers.summary: 比较基线、热痛与条件疼痛调制期间的瞳孔反应和自评，检验二者是否反映同一种疼痛变化。

papers.name: Oncology
papers.title: Worst Pain Severity Profiles of Oncology Patients Are Associated With Significant Stress and Multiple Co-Occurring Symptoms
papers.summary: 用六次最重疼痛评分划分肿瘤患者轨迹，再比较压力、功能和伴随症状；属于临床分层研究。

papers.name: Blanket
papers.title: Widespread Pressure Delivered by a Weighted Blanket Reduces Chronic Pain: A Randomized Controlled Trial
papers.summary: 随机比较重毯和轻毯一周使用后的慢性痛、焦虑与睡眠，区分广义疼痛体验与即时强度终点。

papers.name: PPSTacute
papers.title: The Pediatric Pain Screening Tool (PPST) can Rapidly Identify Elevated Pain and Psychosocial Symptomatology in Treatment-Seeking Youth with Acute Musculoskeletal Pain
papers.summary: 用PPST既有分界对急性肌骨痛儿童分层，比较同期残疾、恐痛与灾难化等症状。

papers.name: CRPSpupil
papers.title: Pupillary Reflexes in Complex Regional Pain Syndrome: Asymmetry to Arousal Stimuli Suggests an Ipsilateral Locus Coeruleus Deficit
papers.summary: 在CRPS患者中比较患侧与对侧瞳孔对光、声音和电刺激的反应，提出自主神经唤醒通路假说。

papers.name: PPSTpost
papers.title: Pediatric Pain Screening Tool: A Simple 9-Item Questionnaire Predicts Functional and Chronic Postsurgical Pain Outcomes After Major Musculoskeletal Surgeries
papers.summary: 以前瞻随访检验术前九项PPST对儿童术后慢性痛和功能结局的筛查价值。

papers.name: TNhippo
papers.title: Pain Relief Reverses Hippocampal Abnormalities in Trigeminal Neuralgia
papers.summary: 比较TN患者手术前后的海马及亚区体积，并按疼痛缓解分组，研究结构变化与临床改善的关系。

papers.name: HBSC
papers.title: Cross-National Trends of Chronic Back Pain in Adolescents: Results From the HBSC Study, 2001-2014
papers.summary: 用33个国家或地区四轮横断面调查比较青少年慢性背痛患病率，按年龄和性别分析时间趋势。

papers.name: CogBias
papers.title: Cognitive Biases in Type 2 Diabetes and Chronic Pain
papers.summary: 按糖尿病与慢性痛有无构成四组，比较注意和解释偏差，并关联疼痛与血糖管理结局。

papers.name: PROMIS
papers.title: Clinical Utility of CAT Administered PROMIS Measures to Track Change for Pediatric Chronic Pain
papers.summary: 用自适应PROMIS问卷跟踪儿童慢性痛变化，结合可靠变化与严重度分级评定临床意义。

papers.name: SCI
papers.title: Characterization of Hyperacute Neuropathic Pain after Spinal Cord Injury: A Prospective Study
papers.summary: 在脊髓伤后五天内及后续一年追踪最严重疼痛，比较超急性与晚发神经病理性疼痛表型。

papers.name: CBD
papers.title: Cannabidiol Product Dosing and Decision-Making in a National Survey of Individuals with Fibromyalgia
papers.summary: 在纤维肌痛患者调查中分析CBD产品选择、剂量及自报效果，并按高THC使用史比较。

papers.name: Disparity
papers.title: Applying the NIA Health Disparities Research Framework to Identify Needs and Opportunities in Chronic Musculoskeletal Pain Research
papers.summary: 将慢性肌骨痛健康差异研究按环境、社会文化、行为、生物四层整理，识别代表不足人群的研究缺口。

papers.name: Education
papers.title: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of the Effects of Biopsychosocial Pain Education upon Health Care Professional Pain Attitudes, Knowledge, Behavior and Patient Outcomes
papers.summary: 系统检索疼痛教育随机试验，分别汇总医务人员知识、态度、行为和患者结局，避免把教育认知改善等同患者疗效。

papers.name: SmallFiber
papers.title: Early Detection of Small-Fiber Neuropathy in Diabetes
papers.summary: 联合激光诱发电位与瞳孔自主神经指标，探索糖尿病小纤维功能早期异常。

papers.name: Fabry
papers.title: Altered pupillary light responses are associated with the severity of autonomic symptoms in patients with Fabry disease
papers.summary: 比较Fabry患者与健康人的动态瞳孔光反射，并关联疾病严重度和自主症状量表。

papers.name: Peripheral
papers.title: Noninvasive and Objective Near Real-Time Detection of Pain Changes in Fluctuating Pain
papers.summary: 将持续热痛中的多生理信号做因果预处理和短窗分类，按人隔离训练/验证/测试，比较疼痛下降检测及连续流延迟。

papers.name: MusicReal
papers.title: Functional connectivity of music-induced analgesia in fibromyalgia
papers.summary: 既有本地记录显示研究比较音乐/噪声条件与纤维肌痛的连接和疼痛变化；本轮缺原文，仅绘制可核定的概念流程。

papers.name: SRPBSdata
papers.title: A multi-site, multi-disorder resting-state magnetic resonance image database
papers.summary: 既有本地资料将其作为多站点、多疾病影像资源及站点效应研究基础；本轮未找到原文，图仅为数据组织概念。

papers.name: Mano
papers.title: Classification and characterisation of brain network changes in chronic back pain: A multicenter study
papers.summary: 既有摘要记录其用静息脑网络特征区分慢性背痛并检查跨中心泛化；本轮缺全文，不能补造具体网络层。

papers.name: NERVE
papers.title: Network-Aware Bilinear Tokenization for Brain Functional Connectivity Representation Learning
papers.category: 连接表征与自监督预训练
papers.summary: 按功能网络对划分FC，用各网络共享的低参数双线性权重生成连接块标记，在掩码重建后提取表征并用核岭回归预测行为。

papers.name: Brain-Semantoks
papers.title: Brain-Semantoks: Learning Semantic Tokens of Brain Dynamics with a Self-Distilled Foundation Model
papers.summary: 把同一功能网络内的ROI信号聚合成语义标记，以学生—教师自蒸馏学习时间稳定特征，再冻结教师做线性预测或微调。
